note: Hillside campground under tall trees across WI-101 from the Keyes Lake public beach and next to Keyes Peak ski hill, with ATV/UTV trail access from the grounds. Under new ownership since October 2025. --Claude
summary: Operator site read (home, rates, about, rules, layout map). Private, new owners Oct 2025. W/E 30/50A from $45 + tax (passes the gate; peak unposted); 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums only. OHV FLAG: markets direct ATV/UTV trail access from the campground (map draws the trail leaving the grounds). Seasonal sites sold ($2,150), nightly share not posted. Google 4.5/90. Not waterfront (lake across the highway). Pin on the lodge, fine.
flags: OHV (reviewer): the park markets ATV trails starting at the campground - home 'Direct access to hundreds of miles of ATV/UTV and snowmobile trails'; about 'We are proudly ATV and UTV friendly, with direct trail access to hundreds of miles of trails'; the layout map draws 'ATV Trail Access' leaving the grounds by site 7 and 'Trail Access' at site 29; rules regulate ATV use in camp. It also sells itself on the lake beach, ski hill and general camping, so it may be a general campground with an OHV side. Flagged, not dropped.

LONG-STAY UNMEASURED: a $2,150 seasonal rate (May 1-Sep 30) is posted and 'Access to the seasonal sites is kept open year round'; the 2025 layout map numbers 46 sites but marks none as seasonal or daily. Nightly rates are posted and booking is by contact, so tests 1-2 pass; the share (test 4) could not be measured. No wording discouraging nightly guests.

PRICE GATE (private): passes. Cheapest RV night: water + 30/50-amp 'starting at $45' before sales tax. Summer peak not posted ('starting at'). Good Sam false (directory). Google 'Keyes Lake Campground' 4.5 from 90.
Rules: 'Must be 21+ to book' (not an age-restricted park); 'Campers/RVs greater than 10 years old must be preapproved' (a 2023 rig passes until 2033).
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed - Keyes Lake and its county beach lie across WI-101 from the campground, beyond the county park. No change.
PIN: 45.8937,-88.2997 sits on the lodge/store inside the campground (imagery); Google's point 45.89324,-88.30109 is on the highway shoulder ~120 m away. Keep.
PHONE 715-528-4907 confirmed. WEBSITE https://www.keyeslakecampground.com/ live. The old map's email domain (yahoo) differs from the site's info@ address; nothing to store.
Old note's 'cabins; seasonal sites' kept in substance; '3-night minimum on holidays only' is now 2-night weekends + 3-night holidays (booking.min_stay).
